arxiv-2011-13742.description: Abstract Context. Radio pulses from pulsars are affected by plasma dispersion, which results in a frequency-dependent propagation delay. Variations in the magnitude of this effect lead to an additional source of red noise in pulsar timing experiments, including pta that aim to detect nanohertz gravitational waves. Aims.

arxiv-2012-00172.title: Deconstructing the Structure of Sparse Neural Networks
arxiv-2012-00172.creator: Maxwell Van GelderUniversity of WashingtonMitchell WortsmanUniversity of Washington, Kiana EhsaniUniversity of Washington
arxiv-2012-00172.description: Abstract Although sparse neural networks have been studied extensively, the focus has been primarily on accuracy. In this work, we focus instead on network structure , and analyze three popular algorithms. We first measure performance when structure persists and weights are reset to a different random initialization, thereby extending Zhou et al. [ 20 ] .

arxiv-2102-12818.title: Form-factor-independent test of lepton universality in semileptonic heavy meson and baryon decays
arxiv-2102-12818.creator: Stefan Groote, Mikhail A. Ivanov, Jürgen G. Körner, Valery E. Lyubovitskij, Pietro Santorelli, Chien-Thang Tran
arxiv-2102-12818.description: Abstract In the semileptonic decays of heavy mesons and baryons the lepton-mass dependence factors out in the quadratic cos 2 ⁡ θ \cos^{2}\theta coefficient of the differential cos ⁡ θ \cos\theta distribution. We call the corresponding normalized coefficient the convexity parameter.

arxiv-2104-06185.title: A General Formula for Asymptotes of Rational Polynomial Functions
arxiv-2104-06185.creator: Lam Mason, Asterios Skodras, askodras@sch.gr
arxiv-2104-06185.description: Abstract We propose a formula for finding the horizontal, oblique or curvilinear asymptote of any rational polynomial function of any positive degree, as a sum of matrix determinants formed directly from the coefficients of the terms in the given polynomial.

arxiv-2108-01870.title: Particle acceleration at the termination shock of stellar clusters’ wind
arxiv-2108-01870.description: Abstract We investigate the process of particle acceleration at the termination shock that develops in the bubble excavated by star clusters’ winds in the interstellar medium. We develop a theory of diffusive shock acceleration at such shock and we find that the maximum energy may reach the PeV region for very powerful clusters.

arxiv-2110-04489.title: Probing gluon helicity with heavy flavor at the EIC
arxiv-2110-04489.creator: Daniele Paolo Anderle, Xin Dong, Felix Hekhorn, Matthew Kelsey, Sooraj Radhakrishnan, Ernst Sichtermann, Lei Xia, Hongxi Xing, Feng Yuan, Yuxiang Zhao
arxiv-2110-04489.description: Abstract We propose a new measurement of the heavy flavor hadron double spin asymmetry in deep-inelastic scattering at a future Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) to constrain the polarized gluon distribution function inside the proton. Statistical projection on D 0 D^{0} meson double spin asymmetry is calculated with an EIC central detector using an all-silicon tracker and vertexing subsystem.

arxiv-2210-11534.title: Designing ReachBot: System Design Process with a Case Study of a Martian Lava Tube Mission Thanks: 978-1-6654-9032-0/23/ $ 31.00 \$31.00 ©2023 IEEE

arxiv-2210-11534.description: Abstract In this paper we present a trade study-based method to optimize the architecture of ReachBot, a new robotic concept that uses deployable booms as prismatic joints for mobility in environments with adverse gravity conditions and challenging terrain. Specifically, we introduce a design process wherein we analyze the compatibility of ReachBot’s design with its mission.

arxiv-2406-13481.creator: Navdeep Arya, D. Jaffino Stargen, Kinjalk Lochan, Sandeep K. Goyal
arxiv-2406-13481.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Navdeep Arya, D. Jaffino Stargen, Kinjalk Lochan, Sandeep K. Goyal. arxiv-2502-10188.title: Installation and performance of the 3rd Veto plane at the SND@LHC detector
arxiv-2502-10188.creator: J. Zamora Saa
arxiv-2502-10188.description: Abstract During 2022/2023 the optimal inefficiency of the Veto system of the SND@LHC detector was measured to be ( 7.8 ± 2.8 ) × 10 − 8 (7.8\pm 2.8)\times 10^{-8} . To reduce this inefficiency, a third Veto plane was installed during the 2023-2024 Year End Technical Stop.

arxiv-2508-20567.title: KCS: Diversify Multi-hop Question Generation with Knowledge Composition Sampling
arxiv-2508-20567.creator: Yangfan Wang, Jie Liu, Chen Tang, Lian Yan, Jingchi Jiang
arxiv-2508-20567.description: Abstract Multi-hop question answering faces substantial challenges due to data sparsity, which increases the likelihood of language models learning spurious patterns. To address this issue, prior research has focused on diversifying question generation through content planning and varied expression. However, these approaches often emphasize generating simple questions and neglect the integration of essential knowledge, such as relevant sentences within documents.

pmc-10713190.description: This study evaluated the clinical characteristics of multiple early gastric cancer (MEGC) and high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia (HGIN) treated by endoscopic submucosal dissection. The clinical profiles of 23 patients with MEGC treated by endoscopic submucosal dissection from January 2008 to June 2019 at the Fujian Provincial Hospital or Fujian Provincial Hospital South Branch were analyzed.

pmc-11438261.creator: Atallah Alenezi, Fahad M Alhowaymel, Abdulaziz F Abaoud, Mona Hamdy Mostafa

pmc-11513377.title: The first assessment of grain yield and associated traits in durum wheat across a decade in Nepal
pmc-11513377.creator: Dhruba Bahadur Thapa, Mahesh Subedi, Manoj Sapkota, Suman Bohara, Keshab Raj Pokhrel, Laxman Aryal, Basistha Acharya, Santosh Tripathi, Chhotelal Chaudhary, Bramanti Mahato, Krishna Timsina, Velu Govindan, Arun Kumar Joshi
pmc-11513377.description: Rapid urbanization and evolving dietary preferences have heightened the demand for durum wheat and its derivatives in developing nations like Nepal. This study represents the first comprehensive exploration and evaluation of durum wheat genotypes in Nepal, addressing the escalating need for high-yielding varieties.

pmc-11522676.title: Optimization of polishing fluid composition for single crystal silicon carbide by ultrasonic assisted chemical-mechanical polishing
pmc-11522676.creator: Linzheng Ye, Jialong Wu, Xijing Zhu, Yao Liu, Wenlong Li, Shida Chuai, Zexiao Wang
pmc-11522676.description: Silicon carbide (SiC) is renowned for its exceptional hardness, thermal conductivity, chemical stability, and wear resistance. However, the existing process is difficult to meet the high standards of uniform corrosion in its polishing process and surface roughness and flatness after polishing, new polishing fluids and technique optimization are crucial for development.

pmc-11539409.title: Inefficient and unique processing of social–emotional interference in school-aged children with high-functioning autism spectrum disorder

pmc-11539409.description: IntroductionInterest is growing in investigating the ability of children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) to process social information under conflicting and complex environments. However, few studies have employed objective behavioral measures to directly explore the underlying profile of social–emotional interference control.

pmc-11606194.title: An example of cytisine overdose with no consequent side-effects: a case report

BackgroundCytisine is an alkaloid that is molecularly similar to nicotine and it is commonly used to treat smoking cessation. While it is considered a reasonably safe treatment option, cytisine intoxication in humans exhibits several adverse effects.

pmc-11644772.title: Predictive Models of Atherogenic Risk in Citizens of Trujillo (Peru) Based on Associated Factors
pmc-11644772.creator: Jackeline del Pilar Bustamante Gallo, Cinthya Stephany Neglia Cermeño, Jorge Luis Díaz-Ortega, Irma Luz Yupari-Azabache, Kazufumi Nakamura
pmc-11644772.description: Background/objectives: Atherogenic risk is related to lipid metabolism imbalance and the likelihood of cardiovascular disease (CVD). The purpose of this study was to determine predictive models based on physiological parameters, family history, and lifestyle for atherogenic risk, assessed by indicators such as total cholesterol (TC)/HDL, triglycerides/HDL, LDL/HDL, and non-HDL cholesterol in citizens of the city of Trujillo (Peru).

pmc-11653710.title: Endosomal Trafficking Bypassed by the RAB5B‐CD109 Interplay Promotes Axonogenesis in KRAS‐Mutant Pancreatic Cancer

pmc-11653710.description: Perineural invasion (PNI) represents a unique biological feature associated with poor prognosis in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), especially in the presence of KRAS mutations. Extracellular vesicle (EV)‐packaged circular RNAs (circRNAs) function as essential mediators of tumor microenvironment communication, triggering PDAC cell invasion and distant metastasis.

pmc-12389803.title: Effect of Aflasafe TZ01® on Aflatoxin Reduction and Emerging Challenges with Fusarium Mycotoxins in Maize from Rural Tanzania
pmc-12389803.creator: Sambwe Fundikira, Martin Kimanya, Rashid Suleiman, Marthe De Boevre, Kokeb Tesfamariam, Sarah De Saeger
pmc-12389803.description: Aflatoxins are carcinogenic secondary metabolites produced by Aspergillus species and are common contaminants of many crops including maize. Atoxigenic Aspergillus flavus strains, formulated as biocontrol products such as Aflasafe® TZ01, that comprises a mixture of four native atoxigenic strains, are used as pre-harvest agents to suppress toxigenic strains and reduce aflatoxin levels.

pmc-12492334.title: Solvent Vapor Conditioning of Polymer–Polymer Organic Solar Cells
pmc-12492334.creator: Michael K. H. Ho, Jun-Hua Bai, Rui-Qi Png
pmc-12492334.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Despite rapid advances in all-polymer organic solar cells (OSCs), challenges remain in process optimization of their donor–acceptor heterostructure. Here, using all-polymer OSCs based on the state-of-the-art PM6:PYIT donor–acceptor system, we show that hot mixing of the donor and the acceptor polymer solutions can retain the desired disaggregated state of the acceptor polymer, significantly extending the pot life from 10 min to over 15 h, without harming the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the fabricated solar cells.

pmc-12619254.title: Development of a novel prognostic model based on laminin α5, associated with immune infiltration and therapeutic response in ovarian cancer utilizing online resources
pmc-12619254.creator: Yan Wang, Zouyu Zhao, Chongfeng Sun, Jishuai Hou, Panpan Yu, Weirui Gao, Ping Yang
pmc-12619254.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer (OC) is one of the most pervasive malignancies in women and is recognized for its high recurrence and metastasis rates, resulting in a poor prognosis. Regrettably, reliable indicators for the timely detection and prognosis of OC are currently insufficient.

pmc-13451693.title: Turning the Tide on Cervical Cancer in India
pmc-13451693.creator: Tarun Kumar Suvvari
pmc-13451693.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). HPV types 16 and 18 accounts for most cervical cancers. 2 WHO now endorses a single-dose schedule for girls aged 9–14 years, recognising that one dose provides durable protection and facilitates broader and faster vaccine coverage. 3 Furthermore, a meta-analysis of more than 902,368 vaccinated women found that one-dose schedules offer protection comparable to two- and three-dose regimens, with effectiveness sustained for at least eight years.

pmc-13501952.creator: Aarya D. Riasati, William A. Goddard, Silvio Osella
pmc-13501952.description: Rising CO2 emissions in the atmosphere continue to be among the world’s most preeminent environmental challenges. Indeed, the solution of carbon sequestration via geologic storage has proved insufficient to combat this problem. The alternative to sequestration is the electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide to liquid products, a common step to combat net warming effects.
